subject.title: [Feature]: Catch up on missed inbound messages after gateway restart

question: Should OpenClaw add a cross-channel missed-inbound catch-up contract now, and should Slack and Discord be the first provider-owned implementations?
rationale: Current main proves the pattern exists for iMessage, but generalizing it changes channel permissions, config/default policy, ordering, idempotency, and provider ownership boundaries.

options.title: Design provider-owned catch-up and pilot Slack/Discord
options.body: Define the SDK/channel replay contract, durable cursor/dedupe rules, and opt-in/default policy before implementing the first stable-channel catch-up paths.

options.title: Land in-flight restart recovery first
options.body: Keep this issue open but prioritize #51620 and the queue/drain PRs before starting provider-history replay work.

options.title: Split into per-channel proposals
options.body: Close the generic scope only if maintainers want Slack, Discord, and other channel catch-up tracked as separate provider-owned requests.

recommendation.title: Design provider-owned catch-up and pilot Slack/Discord
recommendation.body: Define the SDK/channel replay contract, durable cursor/dedupe rules, and opt-in/default policy before implementing the first stable-channel catch-up paths.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses gateway restart behavior, command queue semantics, and channel runtime contracts where their recent history is directly adjacent.
